messages:
zoe_sales: Sea Merchant sent a request: they were charged list pricing instead of the reseller discount during a contract transition. Asking for a one-time remediation credit and Net60 for two invoices while they finalize new PO. Can we approve?
frank_finance: How big is the credit they're asking for? Any proof uploaded?
zoe_sales: They uploaded the signed old reseller agreement and invoice INV-2026-2244. Claim the 12% reseller discount should have applied to $110,000 of Dedicated usage this quarter; theyre asking for $13,200 credit.
billing-bot: Retrieved INV-2026-2244: 
``
Dedicated pool 22 GPUs x 720h = $110,000
Applied discount: none
Tax: $3,300
Total: $113,300
Requested credit: $13,200
``
maya_fpna: Finance discretionary cap is $15k for director sign-off; credits >$10k require comp ops sign-off and will affect ARR recognition. Also need to check whether reseller pricing was active on the billing date.
leo_legal: If reseller agreement was in effect, remediation is appropriate. We'll need a signed acknowledgement noting the credit is corrective and not creating new terms. Also confirm no downstream reseller commissions were already paid.
carol_finance_dir: I can approve up to $15k but want comp ops to confirm commissions and AR to OK Net60. If comp ops flags a claw or manual adjustment, we need to route to VP.
frank_finance: I'll run a quick commission check; if AE hasn't been paid on the disputed line we can proceed. Opening comp ops ticket CO-4205.
zoe_sales: Sea Merchant says AE commission hasn't been paid yet and they can sign an acknowledgement. They prefer Net60 for two invoices to align with their treasury.
leo_legal: Draft ack: "Redwood Inference will apply a one-time corrective credit of $13,200 to INV-2026-2244. This credit corrects a billing error and is non-recurring. Customer acknowledges this resolves the dispute in full." Paste this into the thread when ready.
frank_finance: Comp ops confirms no commission paid on that invoice. CO-4205 notes no claw required. AR pre-approves a one-time Net60 for the next two invoices conditional on signed ack.
carol_finance_dir: Approved (internal): issue CM-2026-303 for $13,200 and set Net60 for next two invoices. Condition: signed customer acknowledgement uploaded to Deal Desk.
zoe_sales: I'll send the legal ack to Sea Merchant and request signed reply within 48h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Action queued: create CM-2026-303 for $13,200 pending customer_ack_seamerchant_2026-05-05.eml and apply after receipt.
